text:
Trevor Moore has missed the Kings' last couple of games with an injury and is a game-time call tonight in Montreal, per CBS Sports. When he has played, he has had a quiet start: three goals and six points in 19 games, his goals right in line with his chances.

The five-on-five numbers explain some of the quiet. Los Angeles takes 45% of the expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), about seven points worse than without him, and the team has scored a couple fewer goals than its chances with him out there. His game is speed. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has 59% of his shots coming off the rush, so the first few seconds after a turnover are when he matters most. An undrafted Californian from Thousand Oaks who has played 452 games for the Kings, he is a useful middle-six winger when healthy. Our range has him around 17 goals. Getting him back would help a team that needs goals.
